The camera pulls back from 0 to about 3s, and from 2.5s the room outside the sphere goes dark with a lit rectangle shrinking and being replaced by black, a blue window at the left and a dark round shape at the right by 3.7s. The image inside stays lit throughout.

clips.caption: A stack of freshly printed sheets is lifted from a printer, and the sheets cling together; a single sheet lifted from the top clings to the stack rather than falling.

After 2.5s the stack just sits still to 5.0s. No hand lifts the stack, the sheets carry no print and nothing clings.

clips.caption: A bag of oranges tips over at the top of a staircase, and the oranges spill out and tumble down the stairs to the bottom.
clips.clip_summary: A white cloth bag of oranges drops into view from above (0.7-1.3 s) and lands tilted on a wooden stair (1.3-2.7 s). From about 2.7 s oranges spill out over its mouth onto the step below and a few settle on the lower step, with small debris specks. The oranges stay clustered near the bag; the camera shifts slightly, and they do not tumble far down the staircase by 5 s.

A thin bolt near the horizon stays visible 0.6-1.5s, and further smaller bolts flicker near the headland from 1.7s to 5s with faint reflections on the wet sand.
